title: Independent recount of the kt carrier census (development half only)

method.events: split.json development_event_ids; one standings.json.gz per event; holdout standings never opened
method.matches_csv: development rows only; holdout rows skipped (used for nothing)
method.window_rank: appearances of a deck name across development-half matches.csv rows (deck1_name + deck2_name, every row incl. byes/mirrors)
method.list_rule: entry counts as a list when decklist has a non-empty pokemon or trainer section
method.card_match: (set upper-cased, number as int) equality against cards.json ids; a same-name item with a printing outside the set is reported separately, not counted
method.placing: standings placing; when None (dropped) the matches.csv placing for that event+player is tried; still None means unplaced (sorted last)
method.dustin_rule: six B2e held archetypes certain; other files mapped by main Pokemon, conservative (in doubt -> Dustin's)
